name: tank-squads
title: Tank Squads
author: johk
description: Train chaingun carriers, siege tanks and flame tanks at a barracks and command them RTS-style: drag-select, number-key divisions, attack, patrol, scout and escort teammates. Shredders park behind your divisions and ram the enemy when a division is in trouble. Veterans may be rebuilt as rare electric and nuclear tanks. Constructors build the walls your robots cannot reach, and fortress rings round your base that divisions can garrison. Native engine units with no per-tick scripting.
